release.title: Version 1.2.1
release.subtitle: Premium subscriptions, billing, and offline downloads
new_features: Premium subscription plans are now available inside the app
Upgrade page fully added with available plans, premium benefits, and checkout support
Billing page added to manage your current plan, invoices, payment portal, cancellation, resume, and plan changes
Offline downloads are now available for eligible premium users
Premium users can enjoy an ad-free experience across supported app screens
Upload quota system added based on your current subscription plan
Billing and checkout return deep links are now supported
improvements: Subscription data is now loaded directly from the backend instead of using placeholder premium data
Upload page now shows your current upload quota and guides you to upgrade when the limit is reached
Offline downloads now check premium entitlement before saving tracks locally
Downloaded tracks now store better local metadata for smoother offline library usage
Settings page now includes access to premium and billing management
App routing improved for premium, billing, checkout return, and billing portal return flows
Premium-aware ad banners now automatically hide for users whose plan disables ads
Dependency injection updated to register premium, billing, offline, and upload quota services correctly
bug_fixes: Fixed upload limit handling so users are blocked correctly when their plan quota is reached
Fixed premium-only offline downloads so free users are guided to upgrade instead of starting unavailable downloads
Fixed billing and checkout return navigation after payment or portal actions
Fixed subscription state handling after cancel, resume, and plan change actions
Fixed ad banner visibility so premium users no longer see upgrade ads when ads are disabled
Fixed upload error messages to show clear upgrade actions for quota and billing-related failures
Fixed several premium route, deep link, and test stability issues
